metadata.title: Gray $\mathcal{A}$-metrics on nilpotent Lie groups and the quasicentroid condition
metadata.abstract: We study left-invariant Gray $\mathcal{A}$-metrics (cyclic-parallel Ricci tensor) on nilpotent Lie groups, focusing on the algebraic condition that the Ricci operator belongs to the quasicentroid $\operatorname{QC}(\mathfrak{n})$ of the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{n}$. We review and develop the abstract structure theory of quasicentroids, and prove a Central Decomposition Theorem: any nilpotent Riemannian Lie algebra with $\operatorname{Ric} \in \operatorname{QC}(\mathfrak{n})$ decomposes as a central product of ideals $\mathfrak{i}_j = E_{\lambda_j} \oplus \mathfrak{z}$, where $\mathfrak{z}$ is the center of $\mathfrak{n}$ and $E_{\lambda_j}$ are the negative Ricci eigenspaces. Endowed with the restricted metric, each factor $\mathfrak{i}_j$ is itself a Gray $\mathcal{A}$-space. Finally, we investigate when the general $\mathcal{A}$-metric condition reduces to $\operatorname{Ric} \in \operatorname{QC}(\mathfrak{n})$. We prove this equivalence unconditionally for two-step nilpotent algebras and whenever the metric admits a nice basis, and provide a general characterization via the vanishing of two trace identities.
metadata.comment: Any comments, corrections, or suggestions are deeply appreciated. 25 pages

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 幂零 Gray A 度量的中心分解
analysis.workSummary: 研究幂零 Lie 群上循环平行 Ricci 的左不变 Gray A 度量，重点是 Ricci 算子属于 Lie 代数 quasicentroid 的条件。证明该条件下代数为理想 i_j=E_{λ_j}⊕中心的中心积，E_{λ_j} 为负 Ricci 特征空间，各因子限制度量仍为 Gray A 空间；证明 A 条件与 quasicentroid 条件在二步幂零或存在 nice basis 时等价，一般情形以两个迹恒等式的消失刻画。
analysis.breakthrough: 用 Ricci 代数条件组织一类非对称齐性度量，并明确一般 A 条件何时化简。
analysis.limitations: 中心积不等于正交直积或 Riemann 乘积；一般 Gray A 度量不能未经两个迹条件就断言 Ric 属于 quasicentroid，二步及 nice basis 是特别充分范围。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
